_doc: Local snapshot of Agnes AI official model availability. Used by check_official_docs.py as the diff baseline. The /v1/models endpoint is authoritative; per-model doc pages under doc_base_* are a secondary signal (slug = model_id without dots, .md suffix). The full doc index is at llms_txt. Update this when official docs change.

free_tier._doc: Verified 2026-10-21 against official pricing page. 'limited' means promotional free period, may end without notice.
free_tier.notes: 2026-10-21 removals from /v1/models: agnes-2.0-flash, agnes-2.5-pro (pricing page still lists it; alpha/beta appear to be the replacements), agnes-video-v2.0. agnes-3.0-pro (paid) flickered in /v1/models on 2026-10-21 then disappeared the same day; pricing page marks it 'Coming soon' — expect it back, add it to models when it lands. agnes-video-2.5 bills per output second (720P $0.025/s, 1080P/1K $0.040/s, 2K $0.055/s). Video 2.5/2.5-flash schema: mode required (text/keyframe/reference); seconds '4'-'12' string; size 720P/1080P/1K/2K (flash 720P only); aspect_ratio; first_frame/last_frame (keyframe); images (reference, flash <=5 paid <=8); width/height/fps/num_frames forbidden.

_slug_rule: Per-model doc URL = doc_base_<lang> + '/' + model_id.replace('.', '') + '.md'. e.g. agnes-image-2.5-flash -> https://wiki.agnes-ai.com/en/docs/agnes-image-25-flash.md. Removed models keep historical slug pages (e.g. agnes-20-flash.md is an official Deprecated page, verified 2026-09-21); the model list above is the /v1/models source of truth.
